text: Election of the Chair of the Interview Subcommittee for Toronto Port Authority under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix AII, for a term of office that ends November 30, 2018, and until a successor is appointed.

The Interview Subcommittee for Toronto Port Authority: 1. Elected Deputy Mayor Denzil Minnan-Wong as Chair of the Interview Subcommittee for Toronto Port Authority for a term of office ending November 30, 2018, and until a successor is appointed.
